shared_elements: upright standing stone slab / stele displayed on a plinth
incised or carved linear ornament covering one broad face
row of repeated wavy or scalloped curves forming a horizontal band
rounded top and irregular natural stone edge
justification: Both are freestanding stone slabs bearing a vertically stacked, broadly symmetrical design in which an arched or nested-arc form crowns the field and a band of repeated curved/wavy strokes runs across the lower part, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ sharply: A is a bulky, dark, three-dimensionally shaped anthropomorphic block with deep relief discs and ridges, while B is a flat pale slab with thin, uniform outline engraving of a framed vessel-like motif, so the manner of rendering and the overall impression have almost nothing in common.
